moments.title: England Rugby Faces Japan
moments.blurb: England's men's rugby team takes on Japan today in a Nations Championship fixture at Twickenham.

angles.name: Match Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's match day at Twickenham! England face Japan in the Nations Championship. Who's ready for some rugby action? #ENGvJPN

moments.title: Wales vs All Blacks Today
moments.blurb: Wales host New Zealand in a highly anticipated Nations Championship match at Principality Stadium today.

angles.name: Principality Roar
angles.copy: The Principality Stadium is set for a massive clash today as Wales take on the mighty All Blacks! Cymru am byth! #WALvNZL

angles.name: Haka Anticipation
angles.copy: It's Wales vs New Zealand today! Who's excited to see the Haka at Principality Stadium? Let the Autumn Nations Championship battles begin.

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Is Back!
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec return to Australia as I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off its 26th series on ITV this Monday, November 16th.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for trials, tantrums, and Ant & Dec! I'm A Celeb returns Monday at 9pm on ITV. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle?

angles.name: Campmate Speculation
angles.copy: The I'm A Celebrity jungle gates open on Monday! Time to start guessing who'll be facing those bushtucker trials.

moments.title: Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market
moments.blurb: The much-loved Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market opened yesterday, November 13th, transforming Cathedral Green into a festive shopping destination until December 13th.

angles.name: Festive Fun in Exeter
angles.copy: The Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market is officially open! Head down to Cathedral Green for festive treats, unique gifts, and that amazing atmosphere.

angles.name: Local Craft Focus
angles.copy: Support local this Christmas! The Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market features over 100 traders showcasing the best of Devon and beyond.

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, Yanni
moments.blurb: Greek composer and keyboardist Yanni, known for his New Age and contemporary instrumental music, celebrates his 72nd birthday today.

angles.name: New Age Maestro
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 72nd Birthday to the incredible Yanni! What's your favourite calming instrumental track from the maestro?

moments.title: Chad Kroeger Turns 52
moments.blurb: Nickelback frontman and songwriter Chad Kroeger celebrates his 52nd birthday tomorrow, November 15th.

angles.name: Nickelback's Voice
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Nickelback's very own Chad Kroeger turns 52! Get ready to crank up 'How You Remind Me' in celebration.

angles.name: Rock Anthems
angles.copy: Happy 52nd Birthday for tomorrow to Chad Kroeger! From 'Hero' to Nickelback's biggest hits, he's given us so many rock anthems.

moments.title: Diana Krall's 62nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Canadian jazz pianist and singer Diana Krall, known for her contralto vocals, turns 62 on Monday, November 16th.

angles.name: Jazz Icon
angles.copy: Monday marks the 62nd birthday of the magnificent Diana Krall! Celebrate with some smooth jazz to ease into the week.

moments.title: Kirk Hammett Turns 64
moments.blurb: Metallica's iconic lead guitarist, Kirk Hammett, celebrates his 64th birthday on Wednesday, November 18th.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Get ready to shred! Metallica's Kirk Hammett turns 64 on Wednesday. What's his most iconic guitar solo in your opinion?

angles.name: Metallica Man
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday for Wednesday to Kirk Hammett! From Exodus to Metallica, he's been a force in heavy metal.

moments.title: Miley Cyrus's 34th Birthday
moments.blurb: Pop superstar and 'Flowers' singer Miley Cyrus will celebrate her 34th birthday next Saturday, November 23rd.

angles.name: Pop Evolution
angles.copy: Next Saturday, Miley Cyrus turns 34! From Hannah Montana to 'Endless Summer Vacation', her career has been quite the journey.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Wishing a future Happy 34th Birthday to Miley Cyrus! What's your favourite era of her music?

moments.title: England vs New Zealand Next Week
moments.blurb: England will face a formidable challenge from New Zealand in their next Autumn Nations Championship fixture at Twickenham on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Big Game Build-up
angles.copy: The All Blacks are coming! England hosts New Zealand next Saturday at Twickenham. Who's predicting a big win for the Red Rose?

moments.title: Wales Rugby Hosts Australia
moments.blurb: Wales conclude their Nations Championship home fixtures next Saturday, November 21st, by taking on Australia at Principality Stadium.

angles.name: Final Home Game
angles.copy: Next Saturday, Wales wrap up their Autumn Nations Championship home games against Australia! Get your tickets and cheer on the Dragons!

moments.title: UK Singles Chart Latest
moments.blurb: Dua Lipa's 'Electric Dreams' continues its reign at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart this week.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Dua Lipa's 'Electric Dreams' is dominating the Official UK Singles Chart this week. Are you loving it?

angles.name: Pop Perfection
angles.copy: Another week at the top for Dua Lipa! 'Electric Dreams' is the sound of the UK right now.

moments.title: UK Braces for Cold Snap
moments.blurb: Temperatures are set to drop significantly across the UK next week, with widespread frost and potential wintry showers expected.

angles.name: Winter is Coming
angles.copy: Brrr! The Met Office is forecasting a significant cold snap for the UK next week, with widespread frost. Time to dig out those extra layers!

angles.name: Driving in Frost
angles.copy: With colder weather and frost on the way next week, make sure your car is ready for winter! Share your top tips for staying safe on icy roads.
